title: Blockchain & Web3
businessQuestion: What settlement efficiency gains justify moving physical assets and bank deposits on-chain?
investorQuestion: Where does value accrue: base settlement layers, execution rollups, or regulated issuers?
overview: Half of these records are already in production, mostly payments, stablecoins and tokenisation infrastructure rather than speculative applications. The useful split is between regulated rails — custody, settlement, compliance — and decentralised protocols whose economics remain unproven outside crypto-native users. Regulation is the binding constraint in both cases.
